technical_requirements: Summary of trial and requested sizing: 3-week Hosted API pilot completed (Feb 5–Mar 1). Key metrics: 25k monthly active users in pilot subset, daily peak observed ~110 QPS on product search flows, steady-state observed 18 QPS. Token mix: ~80% short interactions (<=64 tokens per request) for quick assistant replies and small embedding calls; ~20% long-form generation (200–1,000 tokens) for summary and onboarding flows. Latency targets: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for 90% of traffic; long-form flows acceptable up to 800ms p95. Desired Dedicated sizing ask: reserve capacity to handle 50 QPS steady with burst capacity to 150 QPS for launch windows, support ~1200 concurrent KV cache contexts, and sustain ~20k tokens/sec at peak (estimate based on avg 160 tokens/req during bursts). Model preference: Redwood-verified open LLM family (like Llama2-variants) with fallback to a smaller quantized model for cost spikes. Required features: prefix/KV caching, routing/fallback policy, audit logging retained for 1 year, KMS integration for key management, and VPC peering. Also request bin-level cost estimates (per-token blended) for committed vs on-demand tiers so product team can model unit economics.
